title: Choosing Between the Present and Past

instruction.text: Decide whether the present or past perfect form fits best in the sentence.

atoms.b: Lucy ((has_gone ++had_gone)) to the shop before her dad got home.
I ((++have_played had_played)) the piano since I was five years old.
Liam ((has_finished ++had_finished)) his Maths and English homework before dinner time.
We ((++have_lived had_lived)) in London since last year.
Sophie ((++has_written had_written)) two books this year and counting.
Joe ((has_met ++had_met)) his girlfriend 10 years earlier at university.
I ((have_seen ++had_seen)) my best friend just a few days ago.
